name: emergency-response-qr-system
description: Full-stack Emergency Response QR System with encrypted medical ID, 3-second bystander triage, live GPS dispatch, and hospital locator.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run build && npx firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.start: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const b = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const f = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { b.kill(); f.kill(); process.exit(); });"

author: ResQQR Team
